summary: Frontend-only verification of the Live Workout Virtual Ride refactor. Logged in as greenlantern@roujaune.app at 1280x800, navigated to /workout and exercised all 6 requested flows. Every testID resolved and every interaction produced the expected result: embedded VirtualRidePlayer renders with minimal overlay (route pill, gradient pill, camera/motion toggle, fullscreen button) while the surrounding dashboard (BrandCard, metric cards, ConnectionsPanel, CoachBanner, TerrainCard, RouteMapCard, WorkoutCard, StepTimeline, AdjustmentsStrip, LiveControlBar) still renders. Tapping vr-embed-fullscreen opened the vr-fullscreen HUD with all 8 telemetry cells, elevation RouteProfile, progress bar, interval chip (Warm-up · 6:49) and cue pill. All four ERG presets (Recovery/Endurance/Tempo/Climb) fired sendTarget (visible in AdjustmentsStrip as Target -> 120/185/235/295 W) and Pause/Resume worked. Exit fullscreen returned to the embedded view with workout timing preserved (elapsed grew monotonically 0:22 -> 0:23 -> 0:33 -> 0:36 -> 0:40 across enter/exit; route position advanced 0.1 -> 0.2 km; no reset). Route picker overlay opened from the route pill, listed all 6 VIRTUAL_ROUTES, and Auto-match/Shuffle/select-coastal-sprint all updated the embed name and gradient in real time. Camera/motion toggle (reducedMotion) toggled cleanly with no crash. No red screen, no runtime page errors related to the refactor.

issues: Only cosmetic: RN Web console warns 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow/textShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Pre-existing across the codebase, not introduced by this refactor.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Silence RN Web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow and moving pointerEvents from prop to style. These come from many components (not this refactor) so this is a global cleanup task.
critical_code_review_comments: workout.tsx is 1160 lines — comfortably over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the 'complete/end/route-picker' modals and the cue-generation hook into their own modules for maintainability (not a functional issue).
Two react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings acknowledged by main agent as pre-existing; not fixed here.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing Green Lantern account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Workout embed + fullscreen VirtualRidePlayer refactor verified end-to-end at 1280x800. Key testIDs: vr-embed-route, vr-embed-view, vr-embed-fullscreen, vr-fullscreen, vr-full-panel, vr-exit-fullscreen, vroute-picker-overlay, vroute-auto, vroute-shuffle, vroute-picker-close, vroute-<id> (e.g. vroute-coastal-sprint). Fullscreen ERG presets are text-based Pressables (no testIDs) — use page.get_by_text('Recovery'|'Endurance'|'Tempo'|'Climb', exact=True) and pause/resume via role=button name Pause/Resume. Adjustments strip reflects sendTarget calls, which is the fastest way to prove preset wiring. State preservation is confirmed by monotonically growing ELAPSED across the enter/exit boundary.
